what: 35 thin tick marks (8px spacing, a long tick every 5) stand at the right center of the screen. The ticks around the one indicated by the page read ratio grow from 24 to 48px (long ticks 40 to 48px) and darken to the text color. The spread is 2 ticks by default and widens the faster you scroll, up to 8 ticks (speed decays by .92 each frame). Progress, spread and tick width all follow with .12 of the remaining difference per frame for a smooth ripple, and it rests once everything settles.

options.gap: Tick spacing (px), default 8 — element height = (count − 1) × gap
options.min · max: Short tick width (px) at rest · at longest, default 24 · 48
options.major-min · major-max: Long tick width (px) at rest · at longest, default 40 · 48
options.radius · max-radius: Growing perimeter (cells) default and max, default 2 · 8
options.gain: Strength at which speed widens the perimeter, default .3
options.--fx-tick · --fx-tick-major: Light tick / long tick color (css). Lit ticks use the element’s color

from.where: shared.css .md-ticks — ticks at the right center of every page (35 ticks, 8px, spread 2~8, lerp .12, .92 decay)
